tokens.name: brand-pupil
tokens.usage: Brand constant. Near-black with a teal cast: the logo's dark ink and the app's dark ground. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-bone
tokens.usage: Brand constant. Warm bone; the default app icon ground and the dark theme's text. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-cobalt
tokens.usage: Brand constant. Poster cobalt; app icon grounds, marketing fields. Too dark for text on the dark theme: use focus there.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Brand constant. Signal red; the logo on dark grounds and the one primary action per screen. A fill, never body text.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Brand constant. Neutral paper for print and presentation boards.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground: the window behind every panel. Editor and conversation panes sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sidebar, title bar and inspector panels, one step off bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, popovers, menus, the command palette and cards that float over bg or surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Terminal, logs and code blocks, recessed below bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels, rows and table cells. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes) on bg and surface; at least 3:1 there.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, file paths, timestamps, helper text. Holds 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder hints only, never information; at least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Run, Approve, Merge). One per screen. Alias of brand-cobalt.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons; on-primary keeps 4.8:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill (5.6:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Live: the badge shown while an agent acts in your shell, and the logo's red. Never a button fill. Alias of brand-red.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Label and glyph on the red Live badge (5.2:1). Never bone or white on red.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset), the active tab marker and the selected app icon. At least 5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and inline actions in text. Alias of focus.

tokens.name: on-focus
tokens.usage: Check marks and glyphs on a focus fill (a checked checkbox). Alias of bg.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected list row, selected text and the current search hit, behind ink.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Status: an agent is working. Text, dot and progress on any surface; pair with the word Running.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill fill behind running text.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Status: an agent needs you (approval, input). Pair with the word Waiting and a hollow dot.

tokens.name: waiting-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill fill behind waiting text.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Status and validation errors, failed runs, destructive text. Lighter than brand-red so the two never read as one.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill and inline error fill behind error text.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status: finished cleanly. Pair with a check icon and the word Done, never colour alone.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill fill behind done text.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added line background in diffs, behind ink.

tokens.name: diff-remove
tokens.usage: Removed line background in diffs, behind ink.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the command palette. Never behind text you need to read.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Gloock, one weight. The wordmark, onboarding and empty-state headlines only; never in dense UI.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the About window.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark in the title bar.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans. A compact desktop scale: 13px body on 28px controls.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Pane titles and the onboarding sheet.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog titles and section headings inside panes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Waiting for your approval to run tests.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sidebar group headers, set in capitals.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for anything a machine wrote or will read.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Paths, hashes and shortcuts inline in UI.

styles.name: code-strong
styles.usage: Prompts and exit codes inside the terminal.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Dense by default, like an IDE.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; list row inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Onboarding and marketing layout.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys, checkboxes, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, pills, badges, rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, terminals, menus, popovers, the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the onboarding sheet. The largest corner in the interface.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon squircle, as a share of the icon's side.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only. Never pills or buttons.

shadow.note: Borders do the work; shadows only lift things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon on presentation boards.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar icon buttons, pills.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, tabs, list rows.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary dialog actions, the palette input.

tokens.name: icon-ui
tokens.usage: Lucide icons in controls, at a 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Window title bar height.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels, popovers, tab changes.

tokens.name: duration-glance
tokens.usage: One cycle of the thinking motion.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: One lap of the loading motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default easing for anything entering.
